info.title: CamposCloud API Documentation
info.description: This documentation provides an overview of the CamposCloud API, including authentication, endpoints, and data structures. It is designed to help developers integrate with the CamposCloud platform effectively.

get.description: Returns the account that owns the API token. The account is wrapped in a `user` object.

Returns a page of applications. Without `team` only your personal applications are returned (applications that belong to a team are excluded). With `team` the applications of that team are returned. Unknown query parameters are rejected with `400`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to retrieve.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of applications per page.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: ID of a team you own or are a member of. Returns the applications of that team instead of your personal ones.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Only return applications whose name matches this value (case-insensitive, evaluated as a regular expression).

400.description: Invalid or unknown query parameter.

example.error: "status" is not allowed

403.description: You are not the owner or a member of the team.

example.error: You do not have permission to access this team.
Team not found.

post.description: Creates a new application from a `.zip` file and starts it. The account (or the owner of the team, when `team` is sent) must have an active plan with enough free memory.

400.description: Validation failed: missing or invalid field, unknown field, missing or non-zip file, unsupported runtime, not enough memory left on the plan, subdomain already in use.

example.error: Execution environment 'ruby' not supported. Supported environments: nodejs, bun, python

403.description: The account (or the team owner) has no active plan, or you are not allowed to create applications in the team.

example.error: User does not have an active plan.

404.description: The team (or the GitHub installation) was not found.

example.error: Team not found for the provided ID.

429.description: A rate limit was exceeded. This endpoint accepts 1 request every 3 seconds.

example.error: Create application limit reached, please try again later

500.description: Unexpected error. This is also returned when an environment variable has an empty value.

example.error: Internal server error. Please try again later.

503.description: No node is available to host the application right now.

example.error: No available worker found to deploy the application. Please try again later.

get.description: Returns a single application. You must be the owner of the application, or the owner or a member of its team.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the application to retrieve

403.description: You do not have access to the application.

example.error: You do not have permission to access this application.
Application not found.

post.description: Updates the settings of an application. Only the fields that are sent are changed. Most changes set `restartRequired` to `true` and are only applied the next time the application is started or restarted. For team applications the `canUpdateApplicationSettings` permission is required.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the application to update

400.description: Validation failed: invalid or unknown field, not enough memory left on the plan, unsupported runtime, subdomain or custom domain already in use, `port` missing while exposing the application.

example.error: "mainFile" is not allowed

403.description: You are not allowed to update the application, or the account has no plan.

example.error: You do not have permission to perform this action on this application.
Application not found.

429.description: A rate limit was exceeded. This endpoint accepts 1 request every 3 seconds.

example.error: Application update limit reached, please try again later

500.description: Unexpected error. This is also returned when an environment variable has an empty value.

example.error: Internal server error. Please try again later.

post.description: Starts an application. If `restartRequired` is `true`, the container is rebuilt with the pending settings before starting. For team applications the `canChangeStatusApplication` permission is required.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the application to start

400.description: The application cannot change its status right now, for example because it is still being created.

example.error: this application has status creating, it cannot be restarted at the moment. Please try again later!

403.description: You are not allowed to change the status of the application, or the owner of the application has no active plan.

example.error: You do not have permission to perform this action on this application.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

500.description: Unexpected error. This is also returned when the application is already running.

example.error: Internal server error. Please try again later.

post.description: Stops an application. For team applications the `canChangeStatusApplication` permission is required.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the application to stop

400.description: The application cannot change its status right now, for example because it is still being created.

example.error: this application has status creating, it cannot be restarted at the moment. Please try again later!

403.description: You are not allowed to change the status of the application.

example.error: You do not have permission to perform this action on this application.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

500.description: Unexpected error. This is also returned when the application is already stopped.

example.error: Internal server error. Please try again later.

post.description: Restarts a running application. If `restartRequired` is `true`, the container is rebuilt with the pending settings instead. For team applications the `canChangeStatusApplication` permission is required.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the application to restart

400.description: The application cannot change its status right now, for example because it is still being created.

example.error: this application has status creating, it cannot be restarted at the moment. Please try again later!

403.description: You are not allowed to change the status of the application, or the owner of the application has no active plan.

example.error: You do not have permission to perform this action on this application.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

500.description: Unexpected error. This is also returned when the application is not running (use start instead).

example.error: Internal server error. Please try again later.

delete.description: Deletes an application. This cannot be undone. For team applications the `canDeleteApplication` permission is required.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the application to delete

400.description: The application is still being created.

example.error: This application is currently being created. Please wait until the process is completed before deleting it.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

get.description: Lists a directory or reads a file of an application, depending on what `path` points to. For team applications the `canSeeApplicationFiles` permission is required.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the application to retrieve files from

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the directory to list or of the file to read, relative to the root of the application. Max. 1024 characters; `..` segments, control characters and the characters `< > : " | ? * \` are rejected with `400`.

200.description: The directory listing or the file content.

400.description: `appId` is not a valid ID, or `path` is empty or not allowed.

example.error: 'path' must not contain '..' segments.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

500.description: Unexpected error. This is also returned when `path` does not exist.

example.error: Internal server error. Please try again later.

delete.description: Deletes files and directories of an application. Directories are deleted with all their content. The owner of the application must have an active plan. For team applications the `canDeleteApplicationFiles` permission is required.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the application to delete files from

requestBody.description: List of file paths to delete

files.description: Paths of the files or directories to delete, relative to the root of the application. Between 1 and 50 paths. Each path follows the same rules as the `path` query parameter of the other file endpoints and must not be the application root.

200.description: The request was processed. Check `failed` for paths that could not be deleted (for example because they do not exist).

failed.description: Paths that could not be deleted.

400.description: `appId` is not a valid ID, or `files` is missing, empty, has more than 50 entries, or contains a path that is not allowed.

example.error: 'files' must be a non-empty array of strings.

403.description: You are not allowed to delete files of the application, or the owner of the application has no active plan.

example.error: You do not have permission to perform this action on this application.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

429.description: A rate limit was exceeded. This endpoint accepts 1 request every 3 seconds (shared with the upload endpoint).

example.error: File upload limit reached, please try again later

post.description: Uploads a `.zip` file and extracts its content into `path`. Existing files with the same name are overwritten and missing directories are created. Only `.zip` files are accepted; to upload a single file, put it in a zip. The owner of the application must have an active plan. For team applications the `canEditApplicationFiles` permission is required.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the application to upload the file to

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Directory, relative to the root of the application, where the content of the zip is extracted. Max. 1024 characters; `..` segments, control characters and the characters `< > : " | ? * \` are rejected with `400`.

parameters.name: restart
parameters.description: When `true` and the application is running, it is stopped before the files are extracted and started again afterwards.

400.description: `appId` is not a valid ID, `path` is empty or not allowed, no file was sent, the file is not a `.zip`, or `restart` is not `true`/`false`.

example.error: Tipo de arquivo não suportado. Apenas arquivos .zip são permitidos.

403.description: You are not allowed to edit files of the application, or the owner of the application has no active plan.

example.error: You do not have permission to perform this action on this application.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

429.description: A rate limit was exceeded. This endpoint accepts 1 request every 3 seconds (shared with the delete files endpoint).

example.error: File upload limit reached, please try again later

get.description: Downloads a file or a directory of an application. The response is **always a zip archive**: for a file, the zip contains that file; for a directory, the zip contains a folder with the name of the directory. Folders named `node_modules`, `.npm`, `.git`, `.cache` and `.bun` are not included. For team applications the `canSeeApplicationFiles` permission is required.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the application to download from

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the file or directory to download, relative to the root of the application. The default downloads the whole application. Max. 1024 characters; `..` segments, control characters and the characters `< > : " | ? * \` are rejected with `400`.

200.description: A zip archive. The file name in the `Content-Disposition` header is the last segment of `path` (`download` for the root), with every character other than letters, numbers, `.`, `_` and `-` replaced by `_`. It has no `.zip` extension.

400.description: `appId` is not a valid ID, or `path` is empty or not allowed.

example.error: Invalid 'id'.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

429.description: A rate limit was exceeded. This endpoint accepts 20 requests per minute.

example.error: File download rate limit exceeded, please try again later

500.description: Unexpected error. This is also returned when `path` does not exist.

example.error: Internal server error. Please try again later.

get.description: Returns every team you own or are a member of. Teams you own come first. The list is not paginated.

200.description: The teams of the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a team owned by the authenticated user. The name is sent in the URL and there is no request body. Your account must have a subscription, you can own at most 5 teams and you cannot own two teams with the same name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the team (URL encoded).

400.description: The name is longer than 50 characters, you already own a team with this name, or you already own 5 teams.

example.error: You already have a team with this name.

403.description: Your account has no subscription.

example.error: You need to have an active subscription to create a team.

get.description: Returns a team you own or are a member of.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: ID of the team to retrieve

404.description: Team not found, or you are neither the owner nor a member of the team.

example.error: Team not found or you are not a member of this team.

put.description: Renames a team. Only the owner of the team can do this.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: ID of the team to update

name.description: The new name of the team.

400.description: `name` is missing, empty, longer than 50 characters, or an unknown field was sent.

example.error: Validation error: O nome do time é obrigatório.

404.description: Team not found, or you are not the owner of the team.

example.error: Team not found or you are not the owner of this team.

delete.description: Deletes a team. Only the owner of the team can do this. The applications of the team are **not** deleted: they are detached from the team and stay in the account of the owner.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: ID of the team to delete

404.description: Team not found, or you are not the owner of the team.

example.error: Team not found or you are not the owner of this team.

post.description: Invites a user to a team. Only the owner of the team can do this. The e-mail must belong to an existing CamposCloud account; the user receives an e-mail with a link to accept the invite (invites cannot be accepted through this API). Invites expire after 2 days.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: ID of the team to invite the user to

email.description: E-mail address of the CamposCloud account to invite.

permissions.description: Permissions the user receives when accepting the invite. When omitted, the member has no permissions.

400.description: Validation failed, the user is the owner or already a member of the team, or the user was already invited.

example.error: Este usuário já foi convidado para esta equipe.

404.description: Team not found, you are not the owner of the team, or no account uses this e-mail.

example.error: Usuário não encontrado com o e-email fornecido.

post.description: Sends the invite e-mail again. Only the owner of the team can do this. An invite can be resent at most once every 5 minutes.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: ID of the team the invite belongs to

email.description: E-mail address of the pending invite, exactly as returned in `invites[].email`.

400.description: `email` is missing.

example.error: Team ID and email are required to resend an invite.

404.description: Team not found, you are not the owner of the team, or there is no pending invite for this e-mail.

example.error: Invite not found for this email.

429.description: The invite was sent less than 5 minutes ago, or a rate limit was exceeded.

example.error: You can only resend the invite after 4 minutes.

delete.description: Revokes a pending invite. Only the owner of the team can do this.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: ID of the team the invite belongs to

email.description: E-mail address of the pending invite, exactly as returned in `invites[].email`.

400.description: `email` is missing.

example.error: Team ID and email are required to revoke an invite.

404.description: Team not found, you are not the owner of the team, or there is no pending invite for this e-mail.

example.error: Invite not found for this email.

put.description: Replaces the permissions of a team member. Only the owner of the team can do this. The whole permission set is replaced: every permission that is not sent is set to `false`.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: ID of the team the member belongs to

parameters.name: memberId
parameters.description: User ID of the member (`members[].user._id` of the team).

message.example: Permissões do membro atualizadas com sucesso!

400.description: `permissions` is missing, is not an object, or contains an unknown permission.

example.error: Validation error As permissões são obrigatórias.

404.description: Team not found, you are not the owner of the team, or the user is not a member of the team.

example.error: Member not found in this team.

delete.description: Removes a member from a team. Only the owner of the team can do this.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: ID of the team the member belongs to

parameters.name: memberId
parameters.description: User ID of the member (`members[].user._id` of the team).

404.description: Team not found, you are not the owner of the team, or the user is not a member of the team.

example.error: Member not found in this team.

patch.description:
Renames a file or directory of an application, keeping it in the same directory. The owner of the application must have an active plan. For team applications the `canEditApplicationFiles` permission is required.

Paths are relative to the root of the application; a leading `/` is optional. A path must have 1 to 1024 characters and must not contain `..` segments, backslashes, control characters or any of `< > : " | ? *`.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the application.

filePath.description: Current path of the file or directory. Must not be the application root.

newName.description: New name only, without any directory. It must not contain `/`, must not be `.` or `..`, must not start or end with a space and must not end with a dot.

200.description: The file or directory was renamed.

400.description: `appId` is not a valid ID, the body is invalid, `filePath` or `newName` is not allowed, or something with the new name already exists in that directory.

example.error: Error from worker: A file or folder with the new name already exists in this location.

403.description: You are not allowed to edit files of the application (team applications require the `canEditApplicationFiles` permission), or the owner of the application has no active plan. Also returned when the path resolves outside the application folder.

example.error: You do not have permission to perform this action on this application.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

429.description: A rate limit was exceeded. This endpoint accepts 1 request every 3 seconds. The counter is shared by upload, delete, rename, move and create.

example.error: File upload limit reached, please try again later

500.description: Unexpected error. Also returned when `filePath` does not exist.

example.error: Error from worker: Failed to rename: ENOENT: no such file or directory

patch.description:
Moves files or directories of an application into another directory, keeping their names. The target directory must already exist. The owner of the application must have an active plan. For team applications the `canEditApplicationFiles` permission is required.

Paths are relative to the root of the application; a leading `/` is optional. A path must have 1 to 1024 characters and must not contain `..` segments, backslashes, control characters or any of `< > : " | ? *`.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the application.

filePath.description: Paths of the files or directories to move. Between 1 and 50 paths. None of them can be the application root.

pathTarget.description: Directory to move the items into. Use `/` for the application root.

400.description: `appId` is not a valid ID, the body is invalid, or one of the paths is not allowed.

example.error: 'filePath' must be a non-empty array of strings.

403.description: You are not allowed to edit files of the application (team applications require the `canEditApplicationFiles` permission), or the owner of the application has no active plan. Also returned when the path resolves outside the application folder.

example.error: You do not have permission to perform this action on this application.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

429.description: A rate limit was exceeded. This endpoint accepts 1 request every 3 seconds. The counter is shared by upload, delete, rename, move and create.

example.error: File upload limit reached, please try again later

500.description: Unexpected error. Also returned when one of the items or the target directory does not exist. Items are moved one by one, so the ones before the failing item have already been moved.

example.error: Error from worker: Failed to move file 'src/a.js': ENOENT: no such file or directory

post.description:
Creates a directory, or creates a text file with the given content. **If the file already exists it is overwritten**, which makes this the endpoint to save a single text file. Missing parent directories are created for directories, but not for files. The owner of the application must have an active plan. For team applications the `canEditApplicationFiles` permission is required.

The content is written as UTF-8 text and the whole request body is limited to 100 KB. Use the upload endpoint for binary or larger files.

The application is not restarted: restart it to make it load the new file.

Paths are relative to the root of the application; a leading `/` is optional. A path must have 1 to 1024 characters and must not contain `..` segments, backslashes, control characters or any of `< > : " | ? *`.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: ID of the application.

path.description: Directory in which the item is created. Use `/` for the application root.

name.description: Name of the file or directory, without any directory. It must not contain `/`, must not be `.` or `..`, must not start or end with a space and must not end with a dot.

isDirectory.description: `true` to create a directory, `false` to create or overwrite a file.

content.description: Text content of the file. Required when `isDirectory` is `false` (an empty string creates an empty file). Ignored for directories.

200.description: The file or directory was created (or the file was overwritten).

400.description: `appId` is not a valid ID, the body is invalid, `path` or `name` is not allowed, or `content` is missing for a file.

example.error: 'content' must be a string when 'isDirectory' is false.

403.description: You are not allowed to edit files of the application (team applications require the `canEditApplicationFiles` permission), or the owner of the application has no active plan. Also returned when the path resolves outside the application folder.

example.error: You do not have permission to perform this action on this application.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

429.description: A rate limit was exceeded. This endpoint accepts 1 request every 3 seconds. The counter is shared by upload, delete, rename, move and create.

example.error: File upload limit reached, please try again later

500.description: Unexpected error. Also returned when the directory given in `path` does not exist and a file is being created.

example.error: Error from worker: Erro ao criar arquivo: ENOENT: no such file or directory

get.description: Lists databases. Without `team` only the personal databases of the account are returned; with `team` the databases of that team are returned (you must be the owner or a member of the team). Passwords are never part of the response.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Databases per page.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: ID of a team. Lists the databases of that team instead of the personal ones.

400.description: A query parameter is invalid or unknown.

example.error: "limit" must be less than or equal to 100

403.description: You are not a member of the team.

example.error: You do not have permission to access this team.
Team not found.

post.description:
Creates a database. The account (or the owner of the team) must have an active plan with enough free memory. The database is returned immediately with the status `creating` and `connection.port: null`; it becomes `active` shortly after, so poll `GET /v1/databases/{databaseId}` until then.

Fields that are not listed below are refused with `400`.

200.description: The database that is being created.

400.description: The body is invalid, the password is too weak, the memory is below the minimum, or the plan does not have enough free memory.

example.error: password too weak. use a stronger password

403.description: No active plan, or you are not allowed to create databases in the team (`canCreateDatabase`).

example.error: User does not have an active plan.
Team not found for the provided ID.

429.description: A rate limit was exceeded. Creating, updating, changing the password of and deleting databases share a limit of 1 request every 3 seconds.

example.error: Database change limit reached, please try again later

503.description: No server is available to host the database right now.

example.error: No available worker found to deploy the application. Please try again later.

get.description: Returns one database. **Only the account that owns the database can use this endpoint**; other members of a team get `404` and can read the database through `GET /v1/databases?team=...` instead.

parameters.name: databaseId
parameters.description: ID of the database.

400.description: `databaseId` is not a valid ID.

example.error: Invalid 'id'.

404.description: Database not found, or it belongs to another account.

example.error: Database instance not found.

put.description:
Changes the name and/or the memory of a database. At least one of the two fields is required. For team databases the `canUpdateDatabaseSettings` permission is required.

A new memory value only sets `restartRequired: true`; it is applied the next time the database is started, stopped or restarted.

parameters.name: databaseId
parameters.description: ID of the database.

name.description: Display name: letters, numbers, spaces, `_`, `.` and `-`, starting with a letter or number, without leading or trailing spaces.

memoryMB.description: Memory in MB. Must be a JSON number (not a string), at least the minimum allowed for databases (512 MB by default) and must fit in the memory left in the plan.

400.description: `databaseId` is not a valid ID, the body is invalid or empty, the memory is below the minimum, or the plan does not have enough free memory.

example.error: the total memory exceeds the user's plan limit.

403.description: You are not allowed to perform this action. Personal databases can only be changed by their owner; team databases require the `canUpdateDatabaseSettings` permission.

example.error: You do not have permission to perform this action on this application.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

429.description: A rate limit was exceeded. Creating, updating, changing the password of and deleting databases share a limit of 1 request every 3 seconds.

example.error: Database change limit reached, please try again later

delete.description: Permanently deletes a database **and all the data stored in it**. This cannot be undone. A database that is still being created cannot be deleted. For team databases the `canDeleteDatabase` permission is required.

parameters.name: databaseId
parameters.description: ID of the database.

400.description: `databaseId` is not a valid ID, or the database is still being created.

example.error: This application is currently being created. Please wait until the process is completed before deleting it.

403.description: You are not allowed to perform this action. Personal databases can only be changed by their owner; team databases require the `canDeleteDatabase` permission.

example.error: You do not have permission to perform this action on this application.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

429.description: A rate limit was exceeded. Creating, updating, changing the password of and deleting databases share a limit of 1 request every 3 seconds.

example.error: Database change limit reached, please try again later

post.description:
Replaces the password of a database. Applications using the old password stop connecting until they are updated. For team databases the `canUpdateDatabaseSettings` permission is required.

For MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB the new password is applied immediately. For Redis it only sets `restartRequired: true` and is applied the next time the database is started, stopped or restarted.

The body accepts only `password`; any other field is refused with `400`. The password is never returned.

parameters.name: databaseId
parameters.description: ID of the database.

400.description: `databaseId` is not a valid ID, the body is invalid, the password is too weak, or the database is being created or rebuilt.

example.error: password too weak. use a stronger password

403.description: You are not allowed to perform this action. Personal databases can only be changed by their owner; team databases require the `canUpdateDatabaseSettings` permission.

example.error: You do not have permission to perform this action on this application.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

429.description: Another password change for this database is in progress, or a rate limit was exceeded (1 request every 3 seconds, shared with creating, updating and deleting databases).

example.error: The credentials are already being changed. Please wait until it is completed before initiating a new one.

post.description:
Starts a database. The database must have the status `active` and its owner must have an active plan. For team databases the `canChangeStatusDatabase` permission is required.

If the database has `restartRequired: true`, its container is rebuilt to apply the pending change instead.

parameters.name: databaseId
parameters.description: ID of the database.

400.description: `databaseId` is not a valid ID, or the status of the database is not `active`.

example.error: This application cannot be started at the moment. Please try again later!

403.description: You are not allowed to change the state of the database, or its owner has no active plan.

example.error: The owner of this application does not have an active plan.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

429.description: A rate limit was exceeded. Starting, stopping and restarting databases share a limit of 10 requests per minute.

example.error: Database power action limit reached, please try again later

post.description:
Stops a database. The database must have the status `active` and its owner must have an active plan. For team databases the `canChangeStatusDatabase` permission is required.

If the database has `restartRequired: true`, its container is rebuilt to apply the pending change instead.

parameters.name: databaseId
parameters.description: ID of the database.

400.description: `databaseId` is not a valid ID, or the status of the database is not `active`.

example.error: This application cannot be started at the moment. Please try again later!

403.description: You are not allowed to change the state of the database, or its owner has no active plan.

example.error: The owner of this application does not have an active plan.
Application not found or you do not have permission to access it.

429.description: A rate limit was exceeded. Starting, stopping and restarting databases share a limit of 10 requests per minute.

example.error: Database power action limit reached, please try again later

post.description:
Restarts a database. The database must have the status `active` and its owner must have an active plan. For team databases the `canChangeStatusDatabase` permission is required.

If the database has `restartRequired: true`, its container is rebuilt to apply the pending change instead.

parameters.name: databaseId
parameters.description: ID of the database.

400.description: `databaseId` is not a valid ID, or the status of the database is not `active`.

example.error: This application cannot be started at the moment. Please try again later!

403.description: You are not allowed to change the state of the database, or its owner has no active plan.

key.description: The name of the environment variable.

key.description: The name of the environment variable. At least 1 character.

ResourceMetrics.description: Latest resource metrics collected for the application. All counters are `0` while the application is offline.

online.description: Whether the application is currently running.

startedAt.description: When the application was started. `null` while it is offline.

ApplicationBase.description: Fields shared by every application response. Optional fields that were never set are omitted from the response instead of being `null`.

_id.description: The unique identifier of the application.

id.description: Same value as `_id`. Only present in the responses of create, update, start, stop and restart.

containerId.description: The unique identifier of the container.

userId.description: ID of the user who owns the application. For team applications this is the team owner.

mainFile.description: The main file of the application.

restartRequired.description: `true` when settings were changed and will only be applied on the next start or restart.

allocatedMemoryMB.description: Memory allocated to the application, in MB.

workerNodeId.description: The node the application runs on.

_id.description: The unique identifier of the node.

containerImage.description: The container image used by the application.

exposedViaWeb.description: Whether the application is reachable from the web.

internalPort.description: Port the application listens on. Only set when the application is exposed via web.

externalPort.description: Port published on the node. Only set when the application is exposed via web.

assignedSubdomain.description: Subdomain assigned to the application. Only set when the application is exposed via web.

assignedCustomDomain.description: Custom domain assigned to the application, if any.

startupCommand.description: The command used to start the application.

installDependenciesCmd.description: The command used to install the dependencies.

runtimeEnvironment.description: The runtime environment of the application.

autoRestartEnabled.description: Whether the application is restarted automatically.

status.description: Status of the application. `error` is set when rebuilding the container failed.

repository.description: GitHub repository connected to the application. Absent when the application was created from a zip file.

installationId.description: ID of the GitHub App installation.

githubDeploys.description: Deploys made from the connected GitHub repository.

_id.description: The unique identifier of the deploy.

currentResourceMetrics.description: Latest resource metrics. Not returned by create.

historyResourceMetrics.description: Recent history of resource metrics, newest first. Not guaranteed to be present on every endpoint.

volumeSizeHistory.description: Recent history of the disk usage of the application, newest first. Not guaranteed to be present on every endpoint.

timestamp.description: When the disk usage was measured.

updatedAt.description: When the application was last updated.

Application.description: An application with its team referenced by ID.

teamId.description: ID of the team the application belongs to. `null` or absent for personal applications.

ApplicationWithTeam.description: An application with its team expanded.

teamId.description: The team the application belongs to, including its members and pending invites. In application responses the invite `code` is never included. `null` or absent for personal applications.

totalItems.description: Total number of applications matching the query.

hasNextPage.description: Whether there is a next page.

hasPrevPage.description: Whether there is a previous page.

applications.description: The applications of the requested page.

totalUsedRAM.description: Memory, in MB, allocated to all applications and database instances owned by the account. When `team` is used it is calculated for the account of the team owner.

CreateApplication.description: Unknown fields are rejected with `400`. Either `mainFile` or `startupCommand` must be provided.

file.description: The application source as a `.zip` file (max. 100 MB). `node_modules` folders inside the zip are discarded. Not required when creating from a GitHub repository.

appName.description: The name of the application. At least 3 characters.

memoryMB.description: Memory to allocate, in MB. Must be at least the platform minimum (256 MB by default) and fit in the memory left on the plan.

runtimeEnvironment.description: The runtime environment of the application.

mainFile.description: The main file of the application. Required unless `startupCommand` is sent.

startupCommand.description: Custom command used to start the application. When omitted, the default of the runtime is used: `node <mainFile>`, `bun <mainFile>` or `python -u <mainFile>`. Required unless `mainFile` is sent.

exposedViaWeb.description: Expose the application to the web. When `true`, `port` and `assignedSubdomain` are required.

port.description: Port your application listens on. Required when `exposedViaWeb` is `true`.

assignedSubdomain.description: Subdomain for the application. Required when `exposedViaWeb` is `true`. Must not be in use by another application.

team.description: ID of the team to create the application in. You must be the team owner or a member with the `canCreateApplication` permission. The plan of the team owner is used.

environmentVariables.description: Environment variables as a JSON encoded array of `{ "key": string, "value": string }` objects.

installationId.description: ID of a GitHub App installation linked to your account. Send it together with `repositoryOwner`, `repositoryName`, `repositoryId` and `branch` (all five or none) to create the application from a GitHub repository instead of a zip file.

UpdateApplication.description: Only the fields that are sent are changed. Unknown fields (for example `mainFile` or `team`) are rejected with `400`.

appName.description: The new name of the application. At least 3 characters.

memoryMB.description: Memory to allocate, in MB. Must fit in the memory left on the plan.

runtimeEnvironment.description: The runtime environment of the application.

startupCommand.description: The command used to start the application. An empty string is rejected.

exposedViaWeb.description: Expose the application to the web. When `true`, `port` is required. When `false`, the port, the subdomain and the custom domain of the application are removed.

assignedSubdomain.description: Subdomain for the application. Only accepted when the application is (or is being) exposed via web. Must not be in use by another application.

assignedCustomDomain.description: Custom domain for the application. Only accepted when the application is (or is being) exposed via web. Send an empty string to remove it.

environmentVariables.description: Replaces **all** environment variables. Omit the field to keep the current ones; send `[]` to remove all of them.

name.description: The name of the file or directory.

isDirectory.description: Whether the entry is a directory.

isFile.description: Whether the entry is a file.

path.description: Path of the entry relative to the root of the application (no leading slash).

size.description: Size in bytes. For directories this is the total size of their content. `null` when it could not be read.

modifiedAt.description: When the entry was last modified.

files.description: Entries of the directory, directories first, then sorted by name.

content.description: Content of the file, read as UTF-8 text.

DatabaseConnection.description: How to connect to the database. **The password is never returned by the API**: it is chosen when the database is created and can only be replaced, not read.

port.description: Port to connect to. `null` while the database is still being created.

database.description: Name of the initial database. Only for MySQL and PostgreSQL.

status.description: `creating` right after creation, `active` when ready, `rebuilding` while the container is rebuilt, `error` when the last rebuild failed.

restartRequired.description: Whether a change (memory, or the password of a Redis database) is waiting for the next start, stop or restart to be applied.

userId.description: ID of the account that owns the database.

teamId.description: Team of the database: `null` for personal databases, otherwise the team ID or an object with the ID and name of the team.

workerNodeId.description: Server that runs the database: its ID, or an object with the ID and name.

allocatedMemoryMB.description: Memory reserved for the database, in MB. It counts towards the memory of the plan.

diskUsageBytes.description: Latest measured disk usage in bytes. `null` when not measured yet.

containerImage.description: Image and version of the database engine.

currentResourceMetrics.description: Latest metrics. `null` when none were collected yet.

totalUsedRAM.description: Memory in MB allocated by all applications and databases of the account (or of the team owner when `team` is used).

DatabasePassword.description: Password of the database. 12 to 72 characters, only letters, numbers and `_ . @ % + = -`, starting with a letter or number. It must also be strong enough (zxcvbn score 3 or higher), otherwise the request is refused with `password too weak. use a stronger password`.

name.description: Display name: letters, numbers, spaces, `_`, `.` and `-`, starting with a letter or number, without leading or trailing spaces.

memoryMB.description: Memory in MB. Must be a JSON number (not a string), at least the minimum allowed for databases (512 MB by default) and must fit in the memory left in the plan.

team.description: ID of the team to create the database in. Requires the `canCreateDatabase` permission. The memory is taken from the plan of the team owner. Omit to create a personal database.

username.description: User that your applications will connect with. **Required for `mysql`, `postgresql` and `mongodb`, not allowed for `redis`.** 3 to 32 letters, numbers or `_`, starting with a letter. Reserved names such as `root`, `admin`, `postgres` and `mysql` are refused.

database.description: Name of the initial database. **Required for `mysql` and `postgresql`, not allowed for `mongodb` and `redis`.** Up to 63 letters, numbers or `_`, starting with a letter. Reserved names such as `mysql`, `postgres`, `information_schema` and `admin` are refused.

Unauthorized.description: The `Authorization` header is missing or malformed, or the API token is invalid.

Forbidden.description: You are not allowed to perform this action.

example.error: You do not have permission to perform this action on this application.

TooManyRequests.description: A rate limit was exceeded. See the `RateLimit-*` and `Retry-After` response headers.

example.error: Too many requests, please try again later

InternalError.description: Unexpected error. On endpoints that do not document a `400` for it, this is also returned when an ID in the URL is not a valid identifier.

example.error: Internal server error. Please try again later.

bearerAuth.description: Your CamposCloud API token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
